evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Verify experimental Agy production authentication, AWF, native MCP and safe-output behavior.
intent.acceptance: Partial facet: the five shared protected host assertions establish observed schema, file, inference, shell/environment and tool-round-trip behavior. Native MCP transport, inference accounting and staged native safe-output extensions are separate and not established by these five cases.

evidence.opportunity: Five stable behavioral probe cases per actual conformance assessment on the frozen mainline history.
filters: Only protected host assertions from an approved immutable checker script are accepted.
Agent execution and fixture checks are admission/context, never numerator outcomes.
Incomplete run inventories, expired evidence, incompatible scripts or failed admission remain unknown, not zero conformance.
The later staged-safe-output probe and engine-native extensions are not silently folded into the stable five-case series.
The separate native Agy host gate is not silently inferred from the shared suite or generic engine success.
evidence.collection: Replay normalized bounded Actions attempt evidence. Acquisition and host-script verification happen separately, never per evaluation window.

model.architecture: The same five independently asserted behavioral cases across reviewed immutable checker versions.
model.recommendation: Interpret conformance as observed configuration condition, not exclusive workflow impact; no keep/retire threshold is inferred.

metrics.name: Host-verified core conformance
metrics.formula: 100 * passed stable behavioral cases / assessed stable behavioral cases in complete admitted assessments

metrics.name: Independently verified behavioral cases
metrics.formula: count actual independently asserted stable behavioral cases, whether passing or failing; not successful runs

metrics.name: Observed independently proven core behaviors
metrics.formula: count protected host behavioral assertions that demonstrably pass; preserve this observed subtotal when other attempts are unknown
